summary: UFP Industries Inc. filed an 8-K on June 1, 2026, announcing that its Board authorized a share repurchase program of up to $300 million of its outstanding common stock, expiring April 30, 2027. The repurchases may be executed via open market, private negotiations, or Rule 10b5-1 plans. Timing and amount depend on market conditions and share price. The company is not obligated to repurchase shares. The prior authorization was replaced. Watch for future buyback execution pace; no premium or advisor was noted.
